description: ja->en acceptance fixture (roadmap step 5). engine 'memory' stands in for an MT engine so the expected output is exact; the pipeline around the engine (segmenting, glossary check, target-language layout, validation) is the code under test. Expected values worked out by hand: English has no locale profile, so lines are wrapped at spaces to 42 characters. Two-line breaks prefer a natural break (after punctuation) and then the shortest longer line.
